verdict.rationale: Bento can be driven without its UI. It offers a 50+ command CLI that covers subscribers, imports, events, broadcasts and transactional sends, plus a REST API with key-based HTTP Basic auth, many first-party SDKs, and a hosted MCP endpoint. The site also explicitly pitches scripting recurring jobs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions examples, non-interactive CLI auth via environment variables), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
